evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically to all identifiable members, plus $6 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval.
we can reduce our fee request to $5 million if Brightline increases the class fund to $30 million.

summary: Class counsel raised fees alongside its initial class-fund proposal, and the parties negotiated fees before agreeing on class relief. Hargrove expressly linked a lower fee request to a higher class fund. The transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class recovery for its own fees, defense exploiting fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
